measurement_note: Size scales both n, the string length, and k, the operation budget. Legal tiers 3, 7, and 14 span more than 4x and use distinct consecutive letters so the budget dimension and competing interval choices remain active. The accepted rolling interval DP is O(n^2 * k). A correct exhaustive-subsequence baseline is exponential in n, must return every expected answer, and must fail only scaling without reaching the safety cap.
